description:
➡️ Higgsfield: https://higgsfield.ai/s/thezinnystudio-xHNegQ

Seedance 2.5 just changed how faceless AI animation gets made. The film that opens this video was one generation inside Higgsfield. No editing, no timeline, no syncing a voiceover afterwards. One prompt, one take, with both character voices and every sound generated in the same pass.
This Seedance 2.5 tutorial walks through the full AI animation workflow in five steps, from character sheets in GPT Image 2 to a finished film. You'll learn how to write the video prompt in timestamp blocks, the six prompt rules that keep Seedance 2.5 from drifting, how to keep character consistency across 30 seconds using up to 50 reference images, why you generate 28 seconds instead of 30, how to swap the entire world without regenerating the story, and how to extend past the 30 second limit without stitching clips together.
If you run a faceless YouTube channel, this is the part that matters. Every job the edit used to do now happens before you press generate. That is the shift.
